name: Piloos Slider
description: Open, read and edit PowerPoint (.pptx) decks: text, shapes, pictures, tables and charts, table cells and merging, comments, transitions and animations, speaker notes, find and replace, present and export as PDF or pictures. Works on phone, tablet and computer, keeps a draft of your edits and works offline.
